clause.text: 1. Engagement. ESSI engages Talent and Talent hereby accepts the engagement to act as a Spokesperson for ESSI, and to provide his endorsement of all ESSI products and services, domestically and worldwide.
clause.heading: 1. Engagement. ESSI engages Talent and Talent hereby accepts the engagement to act as a Spokesperson for ESSI, and to provide his endorsement of all ESSI products and services, domestically and worldwide.

reviews.rationale: The clause only obligates Talent to act as a Spokesperson for ESSU and does not contain any language stating that the agreement is non‑exclusive. The company’s playbook requires a non‑exclusive dealing commitment, as expressed in the ‘no-exclusivity’ position. Because the clause omits the required non‑exclusive language, it conflicts with the playbook and therefore represents a high risk.

citations.excerpt: This Agreement is non-exclusive. Each party remains free to provide to, procure from, or contract with any third party for services of the same or a similar kind, without restriction and without any obligation to the other party.

reviews.suggested_fallback: This Agreement is non-exclusive. Each party remains free to provide to, procure from, or contract with any third party for services of the same or a similar kind, without restriction and without any obligation to the other party.

clause.text: 2. Term of Agreement. The term of this Agreement shall be for one (1) year commencing on the Effective Date and automatically renewing annually thereafter, unless either party provides a thirty-day notice of written termination one to the other ("Term").
clause.heading: 2. Term of Agreement. The term of this Agreement shall be for one (1) year commencing on the Effective Date and automatically renewing annually thereafter, unless either party provides a thirty-day notice of written termination one to the other ("Term").

reviews.rationale: The clause provides for automatic annual renewal, which conflicts with the playbook position [renewal-opt-in] that requires renewal to be opt‑in rather than automatic. The playbook’s Preferred language mandates that the agreement expires at the end of the Initial Term and renews only with written agreement, and its Fallback language further limits renewal to successive twelve‑month terms unless non‑renewal notice is given. Because the clause does not require mutual consent to renew, it deviates from the company’s standard and creates higher risk. Additionally, the termination notice of thirty days aligns with the playbook position [termination-for-convenience] for convenience termination, but this alone does not mitigate the renewal issue.

citations.excerpt: This Agreement shall renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term, and the fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than five percent (5%).

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other party, without penalty or further liability other than for amounts accrued prior to the effective date of termination.

reviews.suggested_fallback: This Agreement shall renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term, and the fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than five percent (5%).

clause.text:
4. Duties of Talent and Rights of ESSI. During the Term and subject to the limitations set forth in Paragraphs 9 and 10, Talent agrees to provide ESSI with the following:

A. Upon request by ESSI, two (2) production sessions to be used for the production of the various medias to be used in Commercial placements ("Production Sessions"); the location, date and time of the Production Sessions shall be mutually agreed upon by Talent and ESSI. In the event any Production Session exceeds eight (8) hours in duration ESSI and Talent will negotiate in good faith additional compensation to Talent for time in excess of eight (8) hours.

B. Talent will serve as a Special Advisor to ESSI, whose sole responsibility is to be listed as a brand ambassador on the Websites and/or ESSI related press releases. With respect to Talent's position as Special Advisory, Talent will not be responsible for any additional services such as attending meetings, corporate functions, etc.

C. ESSI may request an additional production session(s), or a media tour or personal appearance(s) of Talent for an additional fee to be mutually agreed upon by the parties.
clause.heading: 4. Duties of Talent and Rights of ESSI. During the Term and subject to the limitations set forth in Paragraphs 9 and 10, Talent agrees to provide ESSI with the following:

citations.excerpt: Neither party shall owe liquidated damages, a termination fee, or any other pre‑agreed sum on termination or expiry of this Agreement; each party's remedy for breach is limited to its actual proven damages, subject to the limitations of liability in this Agreement.

clause.text:

Once the monthly Social Communication schedule is set, the volume of Posts, Tweets and Snaps will determine the total amount of monthly compensation available to Talent. ESSI's Social Media Manager will keep track of Talent's activity pursuant to ESSI's Company quarter to determine the amount of Cash Payment due for the quarter.

(a) Payments shall be made to Talent in the following manner, and to the following address:
clause.heading: 5. Consideration. As consideration for Talent's services under this Agreement, ESSI agrees as follows:

reviews.rationale: The clause ties cash compensation to a monthly schedule and the volume of social media posts, which could be interpreted as creating a de‑facto minimum purchase or volume commitment for the Customer. The playbook position [no-minimum-commitment] requires that the Customer have no obligation to purchase any minimum quantity or value and pay only for services actually ordered. Because the clause does not explicitly limit the Customer's liability to the actual volume performed, there is a risk that the Customer could be bound to a minimum payment amount, contrary to the playbook.

citations.excerpt: Customer is under no obligation to purchase any minimum quantity, value or share of its requirements under this Agreement, and shall pay only for the Services it actually orders.

reviews.suggested_fallback: Any minimum purchase commitment under this Agreement shall be stated in the applicable Order Form, shall not exceed the amount Customer committed to in writing, and Customer's sole liability for a shortfall shall be to pay the difference between the committed and the actual volume.

clause.heading: 8. Exclusivity. Talent represents and warrants that during the Term and in the Territories, Talent will not endorse or make any appearances or advertisements on behalf of any other product which is directly competitive to ESSI's products.

reviews.rationale: The clause imposes an exclusivity restriction on Talent that goes beyond the company's non‑compete playbook. The playbook's non‑compete position states that neither party is restricted from competing during the term, and any permissible restriction must be limited to twelve months, the relevant territory, and services that directly compete (fallback). The clause’s blanket prohibition on endorsing competing products during the term exceeds these limits, creating a higher contractual risk.

This is far more restrictive than the standard confidentiality provision in the playbook, which only requires parties to keep Confidential Information confidential and allows disclosures required by law. The clause's punitive consequences are not reflected in the playbook positions, indicating a deviation that raises significant risk.

clause.text:
10. Termination for Cause

A. ESSI shall have the right to terminate this Agreement upon ten (10) days prior written notice to Talent in the event Talent fails to perform the duties set forth in Paragraph 4 hereof or breaches any other covenant or agreement set forth herein and fails to cure same (if curable) within seven (7) days of receipt of written notice. Such termination shall relieve ESSI of its obligation to provide any further consideration pursuant to this Agreement. B. Talent shall have the right to terminate this Agreement upon ten (10) days prior written notice to ESSI in the event of the occurrence of any of the following: (1) ESSI adjudicates as insolvent or declares bankruptcy; or (2) ESSI fails to provide consideration due pursuant to this Agreement, within ten (10) days following the date such consideration is due hereunder, provided that ESSI is notified in writing of such non-payment by Talent and such payment by ESSI is not made within three (3) days following such notification; or (3) ESSI breaches any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement set forth herein and fails to cure same (if curable) within seven (7) days of receipt of written notice. Furthermore, ESSI agrees that such termination shall not relieve it of its obligation to provide consideration as contemplated hereunder. Talent shall not have waived any of its rights at law or in equity by exercising any provision of this paragraph.

C. ESSI's rights to the use of Talent and Talent's Attributes as set forth in Paragraphs 3 and 4 shall end immediately should this Agreement be terminated pursuant to Paragraph 10(A) or Paragraph 10(B) above.
clause.heading: 10. Termination for Cause

reviews.rationale: The clause allows termination for cause with a ten‑day notice and a seven‑day cure period. The playbook position [termination-for-cause-cure] requires a thirty‑day cure period after notice (Preferred). Because the clause’s cure period is shorter than the playbook’s preferred standard, it is more protective for the company and therefore presents low contractual risk.

citations.excerpt: Either party may terminate this Agreement for cause if the other party materially breaches it and fails to cure that breach within thirty (30) days after receiving written notice describing the breach in reasonable detail.

clause.heading: 13. Indemnity. ESSI shall be solely responsible for all liability arising out of production, distribution and sale of its product(s). ESSI hereby agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless Talent, his agents, representatives and employees (referred to collectively as "Talent Indemnities") from and against any and all claims, actions, causes of action, damages, injuries, expenses, liabilities (joint and several), penalties fines, attorney fees, court costs, and any other expenses incurred by Talent Indemnities arising out of (1) breach by ESSI of any of the terms, representations or warranties made by ESSI in this Agreement; or (2) ESSI product liability or trademark patent or other proprietary right infringement; or (3) errors, omissions, fraudulent or negligent acts by ESSI, its employees, agents or subcontractors in connection with (i) any advertising featuring Talent; (ii) with the performance of ESSI's duties and obligations under this Agreement; (iii) with the production, distribution, promotion, marketing and sales of products including related product packaging; and/or (iv) with the operation and management of its production and distribution facilities, however caused.

reviews.rationale: The clause provides a one‑sided, uncapped indemnity in favor of Talent, contrary to the playbook’s preference for mutual indemnity with limitations. The playbook position [mutual-indemnity] requires each party to indemnify only to the extent of its own breach or negligence, and the [liability-uncapped-carve-outs] position limits indemnification obligations from the liability cap. Because the clause lacks mutuality and caps, it poses a high contractual risk.

clause.text: 15. Assignment. Neither this Agreement nor any of the rights or obligations contained herein may be assigned or transferred by either party without the prior written consent of the other party.
clause.heading: 15. Assignment. Neither this Agreement nor any of the rights or obligations contained herein may be assigned or transferred by either party without the prior written consent of the other party.

reviews.rationale: The clause requires prior written consent for any assignment, which aligns with the playbook's assignment position. However, the playbook's preferred language adds an exception allowing assignment without consent in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets, and the fallback clarifies that a change of control is not an assignment. The clause omits these change‑of‑control provisions, creating a gap that could restrict legitimate corporate transactions and increase negotiation risk. Accordingly, the risk is assessed as medium.

citations.excerpt: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, except that either party may assign it in its entirety, on notice and without consent, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

All remedies, rights, undertakings, obligations, and agreements contained in this Agreement shall be cumulative and none of them shall be in limitation of any other remedy, right, undertaking, obligation or agreement of either party.
clause.heading: 19. No Waiver. All remedies, rights, undertakings, obligations, and agreements contained in this Agreement shall be cumulative and none of them shall be in limitation of any other remedy, right, undertaking, obligation or agreement of either party.
